jobs.occupation: Pediatric Ophthalmologist Wanted for Leading University Hospital
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Join a leading University Hospital in Southwestern Sweden!
Are you a pediatric ophthalmologist from the EU looking to grow your career in a modern, academic, and supportive environment?
A leading university hospital in southwestern Sweden is now recruiting specialists in pediatric ophthalmology to strengthen its highly specialized eye care department. This is an exciting opportunity to work with advanced diagnostics and nationally designated care for pediatric glaucoma and cataract, while contributing to education, clinical development, and research within one of Sweden’s foremost ophthalmology units.
About the role
You will join a large ophthalmology department with more than 250 professionals, covering outpatient care, emergency eye services, inpatient wards, and surgical units. The pediatric ophthalmology section provides comprehensive diagnostic and therapeutic care for children and collaborates closely with electrophysiology and hereditary disease units.
You will work in multidisciplinary teams that include physicians, orthoptists, nurses, optometrists, and technicians, all focused on delivering patient-centered, high-quality eye care. As part of a university hospital, you will also have the opportunity to participate in teaching, clinical research, and innovation projects.
Requirements
EU-recognized specialist certification in ophthalmology
Minimum five years of clinical experience in ophthalmology
Focus and competence in pediatric ophthalmology
Strong interest in teaching, research, and clinical development
Good communication skills in English and willingness to learn Swedish
Team-oriented, responsible, and committed to providing high-quality patient care
Experience or competence in medical retina is considered an advantage

Language and relocation support
A willingness and motivation to learn Swedish is important for your integration and clinical work.
The relocation process begins once you reach language level B2. During this stage, you will work 50% clinically and study 50% Swedish until you achieve C1 level, which is required to apply for a Swedish specialist license (specialistbevis) to practice as a specialist doctor.
Language training is provided free of charge once you have accepted an employment offer.
You will receive full support throughout the licensing and relocation process, including assistance with documentation, Swedish authorization, and settling in Sweden.

What Dignus Medical offers you
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals, if required
Help with accommodation and relocation, including support for your family
Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Why work in southwestern Sweden?
Live and work in one of Sweden’s most beautiful and dynamic regions, combining city life, culture, and nature.
Enjoy a high quality of life with short commutes, clean air, and a safe, family-friendly environment.
You’ll have time for both professional development and personal wellbeing.

Ready to take the next step in your career?
We look forward to supporting your move to Sweden and helping you continue your professional journey as a pediatric ophthalmologist. Contact us for more information, or apply today!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

The Supply chain and Procurement Manager supports the entire lifecycle of our enzyme-based solutions—from procuring raw materials and components to delivering the final product to the customer. This expanded role consolidates the entire end-to-end supply chain, giving you single-point accountability for spend management, inventory health, distribution efficiency, and daily business operations.
The role
We are seeking an agile and strategic Supply chain and Procurement Manager to lead our supply chain from start to finish, from the suppliers we buy from, through our contract manufacturers, to the customers who receive our products. In this multifaceted role, supporting our product line director and the overall company activity, you will be responsible for procuring highly specific materials related to enzymes and biomanufacturing, managing day-to-day activities with existing raw material suppliers and production facility, supporting cost-saving procurement strategies, and optimizing logistics networks. You will also oversee daily warehouse, fulfilment, international shipping and business workflows to maximise productivity and efficiency. The ideal candidate is a master of cross-functional execution who balances hands-on operational ownership and a higher-level picture of supply chain and process efficiency oversight.
You will choose and negotiate with suppliers, plan materials for each CMO campaign, keep inventory accurate across our sites and arrange shipments that arrive on time and comply with regulations. When costs rise, stock runs low or a delivery slips, you will spot it early, bring the right people together and drive it to a solution. This is a hands-on role with plenty of room to build the function your way as we grow.

Key Responsibilities
Manage the purchasing of raw materials, from request to delivery.
Identify and qualify new suppliers and CMOs in collaboration with the Product Line Director 
Develop and maintain the supply base, focusing on quality, delivery and cost efficiency.
Establish and update agreements with key suppliers and CMOs, including pricing and purchase terms.
Plan and coordinate material supply for production campaigns at our CMOs, and follow up on timelines.
Monitor inventory levels to secure material availability while avoiding excess stock.
Coordinate inbound and outbound shipments, and ensure compliance with import/export regulations.
Follow up on spend against budget and drive cost-saving initiatives as needed.
Streamline daily operations and improve processes for ordering, receiving and shipping. 

Who you are
Required
A university degree in supply chain management, logistics, industrial engineering or similar.
At least 5 years of experience in production planning, supply chain or procurement within the manufacturing industry, specialty chemicals, cosmetics, food or a similar industry.
Experience from driving cross-functional collaboration, improvement work and process development.
Excellent English skills, both spoken and written

Nice to have
Experience navigating global trade tariffs, customs clearance protocols, and international sourcing networks.
Proven ability to operate as subject matter expert in a company building its operations function.
Experience in a scale-up moving from R&D to pilot or commercial production, including technology transfer to CMOs.

 
What we offer
A people-driven, forward-looking company of 30+ people from more than 15 nationalities;
A fast-moving, collaborative and multidisciplinary team shaping the future of industrial biotech;
A start-up environment with minimal red tape, real responsibility and ownership, and room to learn and grow;
A competitive salary and wellness grant;
25 days of paid annual leave plus bridge days, occupational health and injury insurance, and an occupational pension plan mirroring ITP-1.

About the job
As a Engineering Consultant focusing on Materials Engineering within Surface Materials at Condesign Engineering, you work on exciting assignments at some of the world’s leading technology companies. Together, we identify customer assignments with our many customers that interest, challenge and motivate you in an environment where you can both thrive and grow. As a consultant, you can work on different assignments over time, and you get valuable career development.
We are growing and are now in need of additional talented employees.
About the role, Role description:
Condesign is seeking a Materials Engineer that will be working with surface materials within the automotive industry. You will be part of the product development and work with both internal stakeholder as well as with external suppliers to refine and develop different types of surface materials for various projects. Project management and coordination, supplier management and interaction, reading and reviewing test reports, colour measurement together with decision making is a big part of the work. 
Travels to national and international suppliers will most likely be part of the role.
Your Profile and Required skills:
Engineering Background
Master of Science in Materials Engineering, preferably focusing on Surface Materials
Automotive industry experience
Surface materials and surface treatment experience (vinyl, leather, textile, plastic, paintwork/clear coat)
Colour measurement experience
Test reports creation and test reports interpretation for decision making and approvals
Project management & coordination skills
Supplier Management
Familiar with Agile way of working
Fluent in English, both spoken and written. Swedish is meritorious.
Driver’s license B
Willing to travel for supplier visits. 

Desired skills:
Experience in supplier manufacturing environment
Material lab environment experience
Experience in Konica Minolta Spectra Magic
KOLA and other AB Volvo related system tools
Available within 1 month’s notice

Personal attributes
You have a positive and open attitude, are curious and have a drive to improve and deliver at the top. You are also a good team player who likes to achieve results both as a team, organization and individually.
About Condesign
Our team of approximately 150 dedicated consultants brings a broad range of experience from diverse industries to help our customers achieve success today and in the future. We are committed to innovation and growth and strive to provide the best possible service to our customers. Condesign is a privately owned engineering company that provides customers with high-quality services and innovative solutions throughout the entire product life cycle, from R&D and design to aftermarket. Established in 1984 in Gothenburg,
More Information
We value our employees and look positively on competence and career development. In this role, you will receive training and education in everything needed to perform the work effectively. We also train for the next career step and work continuously to identify this.
Salary is paid monthly. Competitive individual salary is applied and revised up annually. Salary is based on academic and professional merits and experience, as well as level of responsibility in the role and individual dialogue. We only have full-time positions, no internships or unpaid internships.
We are proud of our employment offer and follow the collective agreement.
A warm welcome to submit your application!
Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

Are you passionate about beer, quality and production processes? Do you want to be a key player in brewing and packaging our award-winning beers? Then you might be our next Brew & Packaging Operator!
Omnipollo AB is a Swedish brewery founded in 2010 by brewer Henok Fentie and designer Karl Grandin. Over the years, the brewery has won numerous awards for its beer and exports its beer to over 40 countries. Omnipollo AB has a number of restaurants and bars including Omnipollos hatt, Omnipollos Flora, and Omnipollos kyrka in Stockholm as well as Omnipollos Tokyo in Japan.
About the Role
As a Brew & Packaging Operator, you will play a central role in our production facility in Kungsängen and in our brewery in Sundbyberg. Your main responsibility is to ensure that our beers are brewed and packaged with the highest precision and quality, whether in cans, kegs, or bottles. You will work across the entire process – from brewing, cellar work, dry hopping, transferring beer, and cleaning to packaging and logging. Together with your colleagues, you will take responsibility for creating a good working environment and developing our operations. The work is physical and requires precision for us to maintain our high routines and industry standards.
Your Responsibilities:
Brewhouse & Cellar work
Milling
Mashing
Lautering
Boiling
Chilling
Fermentation checks
Dry hopping
Tank transfers

Packaging work
Packaging beer in cans, kegs, and bottles
Centrifugation and pasteurization
Logging and documentation of work
Performing cleaning and CIP (Clean in Place).
Preparation of incoming and outgoing shipments of raw materials and finished products
Contributing to a good working environment and improving our working methods

Who Are You?
We are looking for someone who has a strong interest in beer and production processes. You are a problem solver who does not hesitate to take on challenges and find creative solutions. You have a desire to learn and work well in a team as well as independently. To succeed in this role, you also need to be thorough and responsible, as well as physically fit and able to work efficiently in a dynamic environment.
Qualifications:
Brewery technician education or equivalent
At least two years of experience working in food/beverage production, preferably in a brewery and/or packaging facility
Valid B driver's license, forklift license is a plus
Basic computer skills
Technical skills
Fluent in English (both spoken and written); proficiency in Swedish is a strong plus

About the Employment
The position is full-time with an initial six-month probationary period. You will work closely with the team in our packaging facility in Kungsängen, as well as our brewery in Sundbyberg.
We believe in warmth, professionalism, and the idea that everyone should feel at home with us. Our reach is global, but our heart is rooted locally. It is our community and collaboration that make us so successful. Want to join us on our journey?
Send your application and any questions to jobs@omnipollo.com. The application deadline is December 18 , 2026. Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, so the position may be filled before the closing date.
Welcome with your application - and thank you very much for your interest!
We try to respond to everyone who applies to us, but sometimes we must prioritize operational activities and cannot get to all administrative tasks. So if you haven't heard from us within two weeks, we have moved forward with other candidates.

Since 1965, Stoneridge has designed and manufactured advanced, award-winning technologies including driveline and transmission actuation systems, vision systems, emissions control systems, safety systems, and security and monitoring systems for vehicle OEMs in the commercial vehicle, automotive, off-highway and agricultural vehicle markets. We’re focused on the areas of greatest market need – both today and tomorrow. Our core products and technologies are aligned with industry megatrends including safety and security, vehicle intelligence, fuel efficiency and emissions. Join the Stoneridge Team as we continue to build upon our strong history and reputation for quality products to deliver innovative products and systems that address a need, exceed our customers’ expectations, and motivate our team.
Objective of the position
At Stoneridge in Örebro, our Production Engineering team ensures that every product leaving our production lines meets the highest standards of quality and reliability. As a Junior Test Engineer, you will work closely with experienced engineers to develop, maintain and improve the test systems used in our manufacturing processes.
This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or early-career engineer who wants to gain hands-on experience in electronics, software, automation and production technology within the automotive industry.
You'll report to the Production Engineering Manager and become part of a collaborative team where curiosity, problem-solving and continuous learning are highly valued.
What You'll Do
Support the development, maintenance and improvement of production test systems and equipment.

Assist in the introduction and validation of test solutions for new products and production lines.

Troubleshoot test equipment and support production teams in resolving technical issues.

Participate in testing, verification and evaluation of prototypes and pre-production products.

Help create and maintain test-related documentation, work instructions and training materials.

Analyze test results and production data to identify opportunities for quality and process improvements.

Collaborate with colleagues across Production, Quality, Manufacturing Engineering and R&D.

What You Bring
BSc or MSc in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, Embedded Systems or a related engineering field.

Up to 3 years of relevant experience through employment, internships, thesis projects or extracurricular activities.

Basic understanding of electronics and the ability to read electrical schematics.

Interest in testing, automation, manufacturing and problem-solving.

Familiarity with programming or scripting is advantageous. Experience with LabVIEW, C#, Python or similar tools is a plus.

Knowledge of measurement equipment, electronics testing or industrial automation is beneficial.

Strong analytical skills and a willingness to learn in a technical environment.

Professional working proficiency in Swedish and English.

Meritorious qualifications

Experience from automotive, manufacturing or industrial environments.

Knowledge of vision systems, CAN communication or industrial networks.

Familiarity with data analysis tools such as Minitab or similar software.

What We Offer
You will be welcomed to a fun, diverse and inclusive workplace where our culture is built on our core values: Integrity, Customer Orientation, Teamwork, Adaptability, Accountability and Social Responsibility.
At Stoneridge, you'll have the opportunity to learn from experienced engineers while contributing to products that improve safety and efficiency in commercial vehicles worldwide. We offer a supportive environment where professional development, mentorship and continuous learning are encouraged.
This role provides an excellent foundation for a long-term engineering career within a global automotive technology company focused on innovation, safety and sustainability.

Interested?
We collaborate with Oak Consulting in this recruitment. If you have questions about the position please contact HR-consultant Vincent Asplund, phone +46 70-301 99 80, e-mail vincent.asplund@oakconsulting.se We are looking forward to your application! We want it as soon as possible, latest December 15.

Company Description
Welcome to a world, where your ideas lead to something big. Welcome to Bosch!
Bosch Thermoteknik AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells heat pumps for the European market. We are approximately 650 employees and form part of the large Bosch Group, which consists of approximately 417,000 employees worldwide.
We work with sustainable simplification of everyday life where the focus is on the environment, innovation, and development. In Tranås there is a production unit and a competence and development center. The heat pumps we manufacture draw energy from different sources - the mountain, the water, or the air. We work to constantly be at the forefront and contribute to sustainable energy and a better environment with the goal of creating a simplified everyday life for our customers. In short, we create technology that is "Invented for life". 

Job Description
Your contribution to something big
Support and execute improvement projects related to material flow, internal transportation, storage and production line supply
Develop and update drawings for flow racks, trolleys and material handling equipment using CAD
You will have the opportunity to plan and execute logistics-related improvement projects
Collect, analyze, and visualize logistics data using analytical tools to identify improvement opportunities and support KPI follow-ups
You will be Applying industrial engineering methods, including ergonomics assessments, standardized work, process mapping and FMEA
Prepare and participate in workshops, collaborate with cross-functional teams and follow up on project activities
Support project planning, documentation, and routine administrative tasks to ensure projects stay organized and on track.

Duration of the internship: 6 months, preferably starting in March 2027
Location: on-site in our plant in Tranås, Sweden

Qualifications
What distinguishes you
Currently studying Engineering or similar (Bachelor or Master of Science)
Structured and goal oriented. With ability to work independently and approach people easily
Strong interest in manufacturing, logistics and continuous improvement
Basic knowledge of CAD software (AutoCAD or similar) is an advantage.
Knowledge in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
Good analytical skills and problem-solving mindset
Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English

Additional Information
What we offer you
Monetary compensation is included to support you during your internship
We can offer free accommodation in Tranås
To support your well-being, we provide a wellness contribution for use on fitness, sports, or wellness services
We cover your travel costs from your residence to Tranås, making relocation easier for you
You gain valuable experience working within an international company with global connections

Welcome to Tranås – the heart of Bosch Home Comfort in Sweden
Tranås, beautifully located by the idyllic Lake Sommen and surrounded by forests and nature reserves, is home to Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Sweden. Here, more than 600 associates work in manufacturing and research & development of innovative heating solutions for a sustainable future.
At Bosch, we care about you, our business, and the environment.
We offer more than a job – we help you grow in your career and as a person. Life is about balance, and we support your goals, whether they involve new challenges, development, or time for family and hobbies.
Join a workplace that values individuality, openness, and trust, where you can be yourself and be inspired by diverse perspectives from around the globe.
Join us in Tranås and be part of shaping tomorrow’s energy solutions – in a workplace where innovation meets quality of life.
Here, you’ll find not just a job – but a lifestyle. #LikeABosch

jobs.occupation: Bioinformatician with experience in eDNA and AI
jobs.description:
About the job
Microdentify Sweden AB (https://microdentify.com/) develops cutting-edge biotechnology and AI-driven solutions for law enforcement, national security, and defense. Operating at the intersection of computational biology, artificial intelligence, and forensic intelligence, we are pioneering next-generation technologies designed to address some of the most complex challenges in security and defense.
Microdentify is seeking an excellent Bioinformatician or Computational Biologist to conduct computational analyses of environmental DNA (eDNA) and metagenomic sequencing data, using machine-learning approaches for biological and forensic applications.
The position involves analyzing sequencing datasets to identify biological patterns, develop computational methods for classification and prediction, build pipelines, and develop software to deliver results. The role focuses on analyzing biological and environmental DNA profiles and developing models for forensic intelligence.

Main responsibilities
The successful candidate will:
· Process and analyze environmental DNA (eDNA) and metagenomic sequencing datasets.
· Analyze biological community profiles generated from environmental samples.
· Apply statistical and machine-learning approaches to classification and prediction problems.
· Develop and evaluate computational models for geographic prediction from biological data. Create Nextflow pipelines.
· Analyze spatial patterns in biological communities and assess relationships between biological similarity and geographic distance.
· Evaluate model performance using appropriate validation and testing procedures.
· Work with large reference datasets containing biological and geographic information.
· Produce figures, tables, and statistical summaries of analytical results.
· Document computational workflows and contributions to scientific reports, presentations, and manuscripts.
· Work collaboratively with researchers in bioinformatics, molecular biology, environmental genomics, and forensic science.
· Develop an interface for law enforcement and defense.

Qualifications
Applicants should have:
· An MSc or PhD degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, or a closely related discipline.
· Experience analyzing DNA or eDNA sequencing or other high-dimensional biological data.
· Experience with Python for data analysis.
· Experience with machine learning and statistical modeling.
· Experience working with biological community, microbiome, metagenomic, or environmental DNA data.
· Ability to work with large datasets and develop reproducible computational analyses.
· Good written and spoken English.
· Excellent grades and/or publications
· Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a multidisciplinary research team.
Meritorious qualifications
· High-quality publications in eDNA, metagenomics, machine learning, or forensics
· Experience with feature selection and dimensionality reduction for high-dimensional sequencing data.
· Experience training LLMs.
About the position
This position offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of bioinformatics, environmental genomics, machine learning, and forensic science, with an emphasis on developing computational approaches to analyze biological sequencing data and build practical predictive tools.
We are looking for someone who combines strong analytical skills with curiosity, independence, and an interest in developing computational approaches to challenging biological problems.
About Microdentify
Microdentify Sweden AB is a pioneering deep-tech startup operating at the frontier of artificial intelligence, computational biology, and forensic intelligence. We are developing next-generation technologies for high-stakes applications in law enforcement, national security, and defense, pushing the boundaries of what we can extract from biological data.
We are assembling a select team of exceptional AI researchers and developers to tackle complex, unconventional challenges at the cutting edge of science and technology. This is a rare opportunity to work on groundbreaking, mission-critical technologies, where innovation meets real-world intelligence and discretion is paramount.
Applicants should submit.
Cover letter
CV
Transcripts
Diploma
Proof of work with microbiome, metagenomic, or environmental DNA data

Email all your materials to
Nicla's attention at: jobs@microdentify.com

Data Engineering Manager 
Remote within Sweden 
Some travel, under about five days a quarter 
Every request, quote, and booking on Avinode is a signal nobody else holds. Today it sits in pipelines that work but were built one at a time, for the needs of the moment. We're building the foundation that turns it into governed, reusable data: one identity for member, company, aircraft, and trip; contracts on every source; and quality you can see rather than assume. 
We're looking for a data engineering manager and tech lead: the person who builds that foundation with their hands and builds the team around it. About seven days in ten, you'll be writing code, reviewing designs, and settling architecture. The rest is people: you'll lead a small team and shape who joins it. 
What you'll do 

You’ll hold the technical direction for our data platform on Databricks, and write a good part of it yourself. 

You’ll own acquisition, modeling, and data quality: contracts for every source we depend on, tests, monitoring, lineage, access control. You’ll set the review bar, and move pipeline and test code to proposed changes that get reviewed. 

You’ll keep your own work off the critical path, so the team never waits for you and the people side never gets dropped. 

You’ll lead and manage a multidisciplinary team of data engineers, data scientists, and ML engineers. Hire for open roles, set clear expectations, and support each person’s performance, development, and growth. 

You’ll work with the Director of Data & AI on sequencing and standards, with our product manager for data on what we promise, and with Engineering on platform, security and oncall. 
Who you are 

You have real hands-on depth in data engineering on a modern platform: ingestion, modeling, quality, and the pipelines that stay up. 

You have real hands-on experience with Databricks in production: jobs, Delta, Unity Catalog, cost control. 

You have a strong interest in not only the technology, but the business outcomes it enables. 

You have worked with data scientists and ML engineers and know what turns a notebook into something that serves. 

You communicate clearly in writing: you document decisions, data contracts, and standards so the team can move forward without needing you in every conversation. 

You have experience managing or leading a small team, or formally mentoring engineers, and an interest in continuing to build hands-on while leading others. 
Nice-to-haves 

Having been the first lead of a data team, or built one. ML platform experience, feature pipelines, or model serving. 
What you’ll work with 

Databricks, Python, SQL.
What do we offer you? We are proud to offer you a workplace where we have high engagement and where creativity and curiosity is always much appreciated. Your ideas will be heard.
· Ability to schedule your calendar with flexible work locations. · Competitive salary and benefits · Synergy events where all Noders across meet each other to collaborate on a professional level as well as having fun which is equally as important. · Great opportunities to develop certain skill or to learn new things with trainings.
We want to support your development and dreams.
Want to join our crew? Sounds like a great fit for you? You’ll find more fun facts about our Noders (that’s what we call ourselves) and our culture on our website. Kindly apply for this position through the “apply” button with your CV and cover letter in English as soon as possible. We are not able to accept applications via email. Please note that selections will be running continuously so don’t wait to apply!

You will work closely with the Nordics Hub Business Controller, Sales, and other stakeholders across the organization. As you settle into the role, you will gradually take full responsibility for operational controlling across the Nordic markets.

Controlling, month-end close, forecast and budget for the Nordics (Sweden, Norway, Denmark and Finland).
Support accounts receivable (AR) control in close collaboration with Sales and internal stakeholders to keep AR healthy and help evaluate credit limits.
Support the monthly cost allocation, calculate, and follow up on customer bonuses.

Identify inefficiencies and drive improvements across finance workflows, using modern tools, Excel add-ins, and AI applications.

Do you have experience in subscription management, billing or accounts receivable and want to take the next step in a growing SaaS company? Are you interested in financial processes, systems and finding smarter ways of working? Then the role as Finance Operations Specialist at iBinder could be the right opportunity for you!
About iBinder
iBinder is a Swedish SaaS company that develops digital information management services for the construction and real estate industry. With more than 700,000 users, iBinder helps customers create structure, improve collaboration and manage information more efficiently. Founded in 2005 and owned by Fidelio Capital since 2019, the company is in an exciting growth phase, with a strong focus on developing its business and offering.
About the role as Finance Operations Specialist
As Finance Operations Specialist, you will play a key role in managing and developing iBinder's financial operations, with a particular focus on subscription management, invoicing and accounts receivable. You will be responsible for ensuring a smooth and accurate process from quote to payment, working closely with both internal stakeholders and customers.
You will join the Finance Operations team and report to the Head of Global Finance Operations. The role combines hands-on operational responsibilities with opportunities to improve processes, strengthen data quality and contribute to automation initiatives. You will also collaborate closely with the sales team to ensure that customer agreements, renewals and new business are handled correctly throughout the financial flow.
Your main responsibilities will include:
Manage subscriptions, invoicing and accounts receivable, including payment follow-ups, collections and customer inquiries related to agreements and payments.
Work closely with Sales to ensure accurate customer agreements and billing, while supporting renewals, upselling and new business.
Perform accounts receivable reconciliations, support month-end closing activities and monitor key Quote-to-Cash KPIs.
Identify discrepancies, improve data quality and contribute to process improvements, automation and AI initiatives.
Support documentation and internal controls to ensure efficient and reliable financial processes.

About you
We are looking for someone who is structured, detail-oriented and enjoys taking ownership of their work. You are comfortable working independently, while also appreciating close collaboration with colleagues across different functions. You have a proactive mindset, enjoy solving problems and are always looking for ways to improve existing processes.
You thrive in a role that combines operational responsibilities with development opportunities. With a genuine interest in systems, data and automation, you are curious about how technology can make financial processes smarter and more efficient.
To succeed in this role, we believe you have:
At least 3 years of experience in a similar role within subscription management, billing, accounts receivable or Quote-to-Cash.
Experience from a SaaS or subscription-based business, with a good understanding of recurring revenue models and the financial flow from quote to payment.
Strong Excel skills and a genuine interest in systems and automation.
Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing.
It is considered a plus if you have experience working with Salesforce, Younium and/or NetSuite.

iBinder offers
At iBinder, you will have the opportunity to join a growing SaaS company where finance operations are an important part of the business. You will work in a collaborative environment, gain broad exposure across the organization and have the opportunity to influence and improve processes as the company continues to grow.
